run_extract_audio_transcribe: run the script to extract audio from VRS files and transcribe with Whisper large-v3 model
run_process_all: run process_all to transcribe a batch of VRS video takes using Whisper on CUDA
run_extract_audio_and_run_whisper: run extract_audio_and_run_whisper to extract audio from a single VRS file and save transcriptions as JSON
refactor_main: refactor main to accept argparse arguments for root_dir, out_dir, and num_machines instead of hardcoded values
review_extract_audio_and_run_whisper: review extract_audio_and_run_whisper to understand how it extracts audio tracks and runs Whisper transcription with word timestamps
